**Class Skills:** At 1st level, you gain Autohypnosis, Knowledge (the planes), Perception, and Use Psionic Device as class skills. This replaces the class skills you would gain by choosing a discipline.

**Bonus Feats:** At 1st level and every five psion levels thereafter, you gain a feat from the following list as a bonus feat. You must still meet all prerequisites for the bonus feat, including minimum manifester level requirements.

Available feats include: Accurate Planewalker, Aligned Attack, Body Fuel, Critical Refocus, Dispelling Static, Ectoplasmic Power, Elemental Blast, Enlightened Captain, Ghost Attack, Metapsionic Mastery, Nomad's Jump, Planar Pathfinder, Planar Sensitivity, Psionic Body, Psionic Psychic, Psychoportive Pathfinder, Soul Warrior, Telepathic Link, and Tomb Raider.

This ability replaces the discipline class feature.

Because you do not select a discipline, you are limited to the psion power list when selecting your powers known (as a generalist).

**Been There, Done That (Ex):** You gain a bonus to Knowledge (the planes) and Spellcraft skill checks equal to half your level (minimum +1).

This ability replaces discipline talents.

**Portal Sense (Ex):** At 2nd level, you add your psion level as a bonus on Spellcraft checks to identify the properties and command words of portals, gates, and other means of travelling the planes. If you roll a natural 20 on these checks you also gain a momentary vision (sight only) of what lies at the other end of the effect.

This ability replaces the discipline ability normally gained at 2nd level.

**Planar Attunement (Ex):** At 8th level, three times per day you may gain a +10 enhancement bonus on portal sense checks. This ability can be used an additional time per day every two psion levels thereafter. In addition, at will you may expend your psionic focus to manifest detect teleportation. There is no power point cost for manifesting this ability.

This ability replaces the discipline ability normally gained at 8th level.

**Planar Relocation (Su):** At 14th level, you can use planar travel as a psi-like ability once per day per point of your primary attribute bonus.

This ability replaces the discipline ability normally gained at 14th level.

**Portal Empathy (Ex):** At will, at 20th level you can identify all properties, keys, and command words of any gate or portal by touching it for one round.

This ability replaces the discipline ability normally gained at 20th level.
